title: Pop-up Art (Blocked)
summary: Pop Art opened as an unsolicited pop-up window: the browser's built-in pop-up blocker rules on it, and when consented to, Hamilton's 1957 definition of Pop runs for 11 seconds, then the window closes itself.
mechanism: An unsolicited window.open() on load whose null return (the browser's default pop-up blocker) is reported as the verdict; a consent click opens a locally written about:blank pop-up that window.close()s itself after 11 seconds; no network, no storage.
references: Richard Hamilton, letter to Alison and Peter Smithson (16 January 1957), the definition of Pop Art
Richard Hamilton, Just what is it that makes today's homes so different, so appealing? (1956)
The pop-up ad and default browser pop-up blockers (Opera, Mozilla, Internet Explorer XP SP2, 2000-2004)
